name: Makueni North Candidate
label: illustrative, validate locally
caveat: Makueni cropland is unverified. Results are illustrative and conditional on the assumed baseline.
credit_evidence: Regional trials suggest an uncertain range of roughly 1–80 kg N/ha for bean credit. They estimate fertilizer equivalence for following maize in specific trial conditions. Transfer to this farm and to other successor crops is an assumption, validate locally.
baseline_source: assumption, validate locally; long-rains maize and short-rains beans not verified at point
